metadata.title: Anggur Asinba Athumba Thongba | Manipuri Recipe
metadata.description:
In this video I have given a slight twist to the traditional sweet and tangy athumba recipe with the inclusion of green grapes locally known as Anggur. Our Anggur Asinba Athumba Thongba, is exactly same recipe as the Khamen Asinba Athumba Tongba except that the roma tomatoes have been replaced with sour grapes.

I got this recipe from a boggler and here is the link to the blog, it's an amazing wordpress blog with great recipes. 

Link to the Blog: https://pushpitaschakhum.wordpress.com/2017/02/05/manipuri-sour-grapes-relish-anggur-asinba-athumba-thongba/
